title: docs.issue-draft.ready.v1
description: Docs drafted a GitHub issue from a study note, answering flow.issue-draft.requested.v1. Nothing is created on GitHub yet: the owner approves the draft in Flow first. requestId is the id of the request event answered, so Flow can drop a late answer to an earlier attempt.

stepId.description: The run's step that waits for the answer (from the request)

requestId.description: The id of the flow.issue-draft.requested.v1 event this answers

docPath.description: The note's document, its path in the source repository

repo.description: The target repository (owner/name): the one that owns the document

public.description: True when the target repository is public

labels.description: Labels the target repository already has
